source_last_update_note: The returned calculation did not state a last-information-update date; the date above is the retrieval date, not a claimed source update.
model_note: OPALE reports spherical Sun and Moon at greatest, lunar radius 1738.091 km, solar radius 695700 km, WGS84. Moira uses DE441 and a different mean lunar radius; this is an ordinary total-eclipse control, not a one-limit reference.
tolerance_note: Cross-model regression gates, not estimates of physical accuracy; event time is rounded to the second in the OPALE response. The lunar-radius model difference materially affects magnitude.
